description: This Java source file defines the final class 'DefaultHttpPushFactory' which implements the 'HttpPushFactory' interface. It provides methods to create HTTP requests, configure HTTP connection flows using Akka HTTP, and manage connection settings, including SSL contexts for secure connections. This class appears central to the HTTP push messaging mechanism within the project.

classes.name: DefaultHttpPushFactory
classes.description: Implementation of HttpPushFactory responsible for creating and managing HTTP connection flows and requests, handling SSL contexts, and connection configuration for HTTP push messaging.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultHttpPushFactory based on a Connection object, HttpPushConfig, and ConnectionLogger. Sets up SSL context if the connection scheme is secure.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new HTTP request for a specified HttpPublishTarget, including URI, method, and optional credentials.

methods.name: createFlow
methods.description: Creates a Akka Stream Flow for HTTP connection pooling, supporting both HTTP and HTTPS based on the configuration.
